name: Myogadani
tagline: Bunkyo Ward's academic quarter — 12 minutes to Otemachi, and very quiet at night.
summary: The Marunouchi Line gives no-transfer rides to Otemachi in 12 minutes, Tokyo Station in 15 and Shinjuku in 18. This is an academic district with several national university-affiliated schools, and safety and quiet rank near the top among areas this close to the centre. Kyoiku-no-Mori Park is a short walk. The only line is the Marunouchi.
goodFor: People who put safety and quiet first
People commuting to Otemachi or Marunouchi
notFor: People who want restaurants and nightlife
Single people trying to keep rent low
People who want more than one line
residentComment: One of the calmest stations in an already calm ward. It is hard to believe how quiet the streets are five kilometres from the centre. It may be dull if you live alone, but the family appeal is well earned.
